name: rimagentic
description: An agent-driven RimWorld modding toolkit: discover, build, deploy, launch and test any RimWorld mod, with a live in-game tool bridge and bundled modding docs.
long_description: RimAgentic lets a frontier-model agent develop RimWorld mods. Mod tools discover the mods in a workspace, resolve load order from About.xml, build C# in dependency order, deploy into the game's Mods folder, launch an isolated dev instance, run the in-game test suite, and parse Player.log into classified errors, Harmony patch failures, missing dependencies and test results. A bundled modding knowledge base teaches the agent how to mod (Defs, XML patches, C#/Harmony, load order). Game IPC tools call into a running game via the companion RimAgentic game mod, which exposes the base game + DLC surface (defs, incidents, reflected debug actions, pawn/object/map state) and lets other mods register their own tools dynamically. GitHub tools (the only family needing a token) manage issues, boards and wikis; desktop-control tools drive mouse/keyboard/screen for cases with no data path. A failure in any one family disables only that family, not the whole server.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new GitHub issue in a repository

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search for issues and pull requests

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing GitHub issue or pull request

tools.name: add_project_item
tools.description: Add an issue or pull request to the RimSynapse Roadmap project.

tools.name: get_project_items
tools.description: Get all items currently on the RimSynapse Roadmap project.

tools.name: update_project_item_status
tools.description: Update the status of a project item (e.g. 'Todo', 'In progress', 'Done').

tools.name: cleanup_project_board
tools.description: Scans the project board for any items that are marked as CLOSED on GitHub, and automatically moves their project status to 'Done'.

tools.name: update_project_item_iteration
tools.description: Assigns a project item to a specific sprint/iteration.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Get the content of a file from a repository

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a file in a repository

tools.name: create_testing_plan_issues
tools.description: Parse a local testing plan Markdown file, add it as a comment to the issue, and set the project item status to 'Testing'

tools.name: restart_game
tools.description: Brings down the running RimWorld process and relaunches it with quicktest developer mode (-quicktest) enabled to bypass the main menu and load a test colony immediately.

tools.name: configure_active_mods
tools.description: Configures active mods and DLCs in RimWorld's ModsConfig.xml with official-first, dependency-aware load order. Auto-activates installed HARD dependencies (<modDependencies>) the chosen mods require, and errors when a required prerequisite is not installed. Resolves file path dynamically.

tools.name: resolve_mod_load_order
tools.description: Read-only. Resolves mod packageIds into RimWorld load order (official block first, then a topological sort of declared loadAfter/loadBefore/modDependencies) and returns { resolved, ambiguous, cycles, uninstalled, missingDependencies } — the last being unsatisfied hard dependencies — without writing ModsConfig.

tools.name: list_installed_mods
tools.description: Read-only. Lists every installed mod (local Mods, Steam Workshop, and game Data folders) with packageId, name, source, and folder.

tools.name: get_mod_metadata
tools.description: Read-only. Reads a mod's About.xml by packageId and returns name, author, description, supportedVersions, and all load-order/dependency/incompatibility declarations.

tools.name: detect_mod_conflicts
tools.description: Read-only. Analyzes a mod set (or the active ModsConfig list) for duplicate packageIds (shadowing), incompatibleWith pairs both active, load-order cycles, and unsatisfied hard dependencies. Returns { conflictCount, duplicatePackageIds, incompatiblePairs, cycles, missingDependencies }.

tools.name: sync_repo_wiki
tools.description: Syncs a local Learning folder to its GitHub Wiki repository

tools.name: query_modding_docs
tools.description: Read the bundled RimWorld modding knowledge base (mod structure, Defs/XML, XML patches, C#/Harmony, load order, and how to drive this toolkit to launch/test/evaluate). List, read, or search the docs.

tools.name: set_anthropic_key
tools.description: Store your Anthropic API key for enrich_api_corpus. With no argument, opens a small window to paste your key into; it is saved locally, used immediately (no restart), and never shown in chat or committed to git.

tools.name: set_github_token
tools.description: Store a GitHub PAT in the local keyring so the issue/project-board/codebase/sync tools authenticate as you, not the gh CLI's scope-poor keyring token. With no argument, opens a small window to paste your PAT into; saved locally, used immediately (no restart), never shown in chat or committed. Supports multiple PATs via `label` (e.g. one per org); the new key becomes active. For org boards the PAT needs repo + read:org + project (or fine-grained: Projects/Issues/Contents RW, Metadata R).

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: List stored GitHub PATs and Anthropic API keys (values masked): service, label, active flag, added date, recorded expiry, and expired flag. Pass verify:true to live-check each against GitHub/Anthropic. Use to find expired or irrelevant keys to delete.

tools.name: delete_key
tools.description: Delete a stored key by service + label (from list_keys). If it was active, the next remaining key is promoted and applied to the running server. Use to remove expired or irrelevant keys.

tools.name: set_active_key
tools.description: Choose which stored key is active for a service (e.g. switch between a RimSynapse-org PAT and a personal PAT). Applied to the running server immediately — no restart.

tools.name: suppress_rimsort_warnings
tools.description: Silence RimSort's noisy startup dialogs for a mod developer: the 'Mods with Missing Properties' popup (fires for every local/unpublished mod with no Steam PublishedFileId) and the 'Duplicate mods' popup. Sets duplicate_mods_warning=false and auto-adds every local mod missing About/PublishedFileId.txt to RimSort's ignore list. Read live by RimSort (no restart), idempotent, and touches only RimSort config — never your mods.

tools.name: simulate_llm_prompt
tools.description: Universal game-free RimSynapse prompt/response harness. Composes the EXACT prompt a given LLM call site (family, e.g. 'conversation' or 'newspaper') would send — via that mod's pure composer — and (unless dryRun) sends it to the same local model the game uses (reading the live Core config), returning the RAW response plus the composed system/user, an optional family parse, and metadata. Does NOT judge — parse/score the raw yourself for your use case. mode 'suite' runs the family's built-in catalog; 'scenario' runs your own inputs. Families are discovered from whichever mod composers are present in the workspace (call list_prompt_families first). Needs dotnet and, for real calls, the LLM reachable.

tools.name: list_prompt_families
tools.description: List the registered PromptLab families (LLM call sites made testable) with each family's description, built-in catalog size, and input contract (field names, types, and where the game reads them). A family only appears if its mod's pure composer is present in the workspace. No LLM call.

tools.name: enrich_api_corpus
tools.description: Enrich the API corpus with a one-line semantic description per type, generated by a frontier model that knows RimWorld/C#, so search_game_api can match on concept, not just identifier. Writes `desc` back into the corpus; run build_api_index afterwards. Needs an Anthropic key (see set_anthropic_key).

tools.name: build_api_index
tools.description: Build the local semantic embedding index (MiniLM, no external service) over the API corpus so search_game_api can do concept/natural-language lookup. Run once after dump_game_api (and after enrich_api_corpus, to embed descriptions).

tools.name: search_game_api
tools.description: Search the RimWorld C# API for a query, blending semantic similarity (concept matches) with keyword relevance (exact names); returns matching types with member signatures for writing C#/Harmony.

tools.name: build_api_graph
tools.description: Build a structural graph over the API corpus (inheritance edges + which types each member yields/references) so query_api_graph can navigate type relationships. Run once after dump_game_api.

tools.name: query_api_graph
tools.description: Query the API graph for a type's relationships text search can't answer: ancestors (inheritance chain), subclasses (what extends it), returns (what yields/exposes this type), uses, and usedby.

tools.name: perf_baseline_save
tools.description: Store an in-game benchmark result as the performance baseline for a scenario (captured once with the mod-under-test off), keyed by scenarioId + a fingerprint (game version + other active mods), so baselines are reused across playtests instead of recaptured.

tools.name: perf_baseline_list
tools.description: List stored performance baselines (scenarioId, fingerprint, avg ms/tick, capture time). Read-only.

tools.name: perf_impact
tools.description: Compare a fresh mod-on benchmark result to the stored baseline for the same scenario and return the performance impact: tick-time delta (ms/tick + percent) and a plain verdict (none/negligible/minor/moderate/heavy). Answers 'how much does my mod cost the game'.

tools.name: capture_workshop_image
tools.description: Capture the screen (or a region) and save it as a Steam-Workshop-ready JPEG (scaled + re-encoded) for embedding 'pages' of visual content in an item description, past the ~8,000-character cap.

tools.name: make_workshop_image
tools.description: Process an existing image file into a Steam-Workshop-ready JPEG: optional crop, scale to a max width, re-encode at a quality, save to the workshop-images folder.

tools.name: list_workshop_images
tools.description: List the Workshop JPEGs produced so far (name, path, dimensions, byte size). Read-only.

tools.name: compose_workshop_bbcode
tools.description: Compose Steam Workshop description BBCode embedding a set of Steam-hosted image URLs (with optional captions), combined with an intro and/or existing description — ready to pass to swh_update_description.

tools.name: render_workshop_infographic
tools.description: Render one Workshop description panel as a PNG (800px wide, real font rendering): a notched-hexagon section ribbon (800x74) or a feature panel whose height derives from its content (glyph tile, subtitle, accent flavor line, body, bullet rows, Requires chip). One swappable brand accent; fixed neutral ramp.

tools.name: compose_workshop_page
tools.description: Render a whole Workshop description page in one call: an ordered list of header/feature/image blocks rendered to numbered PNGs sharing one brand accent and icon setup, with optional merge into one tall image. Draft-first: local files only.

tools.name: render_tile
tools.description: Render one feature-panel tile card (158x158) as a PNG from a built-in monoline glyph or an external art image; compose_workshop_page reuses it via the override gate.

tools.name: render_workshop_preview
tools.description: Render the mod's preview card from one source spec to two PNGs: 640x360 (mod list) and 512x512 (Workshop thumbnail) — gradient ground, accent bars, centred glyph above the wordmark. Draft-first: local files only.

tools.name: merge_workshop_tiles
tools.description: Stack rendered page PNGs vertically into one (or a few) tall images so a whole description embeds a single hosted URL; auto-splits to stay under the 700 KB performance target.

tools.name: list_item_icons
tools.description: List the icons available in the local icon library (populated by dump_item_icons) that feature panels resolve against. Read-only.

tools.name: resolve_item_icon
tools.description: Resolve an icon ref (file path, RimWorld texPath, or bare defName) to the PNG the infographic tools would use, without rendering. Read-only.

tools.name: showcase_add
tools.description: Store a passing positive UI-test screenshot as a captioned, Steam-ready showcase item (scaled JPEG + manifest entry with caption/element/mod) for later Workshop description uploads. Called from the ui-test protocol on each positive pass.

tools.name: showcase_list
tools.description: List stored showcase items (passing positive UI cases) with captions, element, mod, and file paths — the material for a Steam Workshop description upload. Optionally filter by mod. Read-only.

tools.name: showcase_remove
tools.description: Remove a stored showcase item by id (deletes the manifest entry and its JPEG).

tools.name: imgur_login
tools.description: Authorize this server against your imgur account (OAuth2) so generated images can be hosted for Steam Workshop descriptions, or store a bare Client-ID for anonymous uploads. Opens the browser, catches the loopback redirect, saves tokens to the local keyring.

tools.name: imgur_status
tools.description: Report imgur auth state: active account or anonymous mode, access-token validity and expiry, remaining upload quota, and local ledger size.

tools.name: imgur_upload
tools.description: Upload local images (explicit paths, or showcase items by mod/id) to imgur and return hosted URLs plus a ready-made {url, caption} list for compose_workshop_bbcode. Deduplicated by file content hash; supports albums.

tools.name: imgur_list_uploads
tools.description: List images uploaded to imgur from this machine (link, id, deletehash, source file, caption, mod, album), filterable by mod or album.

tools.name: imgur_delete
tools.description: Delete an uploaded imgur image by deletehash, id, or i.imgur.com link, and drop it from the local ledger. Irreversible.

tools.name: imgur_web_upload
tools.description: Upload image(s) through the RimAgentic Chrome's logged-in imgur session over CDP (no API credentials needed): sets the upload page's file input directly — no window focus, no drag-drop UI — returns post URL + verified direct link per file, and records them in the shared upload ledger.

tools.name: imgur_resolve
tools.description: Turn any imgur reference (album/gallery/image-page/direct URL or bare hash) into direct, embeddable full-size image URLs — local ledger first (zero network), then the imgur API, then a normalised HTML scrape with optional verification of real dimensions.

tools.name: launch_chrome
tools.description: Launch (or reuse) the RimAgentic Chrome instance on its own profile with the repo extension installed over CDP and remote debugging enabled, so browser-driven tools work without you opening a browser. Never touches your normal Chrome profile.

tools.name: chrome_status
tools.description: Report the RimAgentic Chrome instance: running state, debugging port, pids, whether the extension's service worker is alive, bridge connectivity, and the current tab list.

tools.name: close_chrome
tools.description: Close the RimAgentic Chrome instance — only processes running against its dedicated profile, never your normal windows.

tools.name: chrome_tabs
tools.description: List the RimAgentic Chrome instance's tabs and tab groups (title, colour, collapsed state, members), plus ungrouped tabs and duplicate URLs. Read-only.

tools.name: chrome_tidy
tools.description: Aggressively tidy the RimAgentic Chrome tabs and groups: close duplicates and idle tabs, dissolve singleton/empty groups, re-group survivors by site with stable names, and collapse inactive groups. Supports dryRun.

tools.name: validate_mod_defs
tools.description: Pre-launch Def check: reports malformed XML (file + line) and C# class references (Class="..." / <*Class>) that don't resolve to a real type, validated against the api-corpus plus the mod's own C# — catches typos before a wasted launch cycle.

tools.name: build_def_corpus
tools.description: Parse the game's and DLCs' Def XML into an offline searchable catalog of every def (defType, defName, label, description, inheritance, module). The content half of mechanics, available without launching. Run once.

tools.name: search_defs
tools.description: Search the offline Def corpus by concept/keyword across defName/label/description, optionally filtered by defType. Pair with search_game_api (the C# behind the def). Requires build_def_corpus.

tools.name: register_corpus
tools.description: Register any structured records as a named corpus (from inline objects or a JSONL/JSON file) so the agent can search and graph it like the built-in API/Def corpora. Auto-detects idField and textFields.

tools.name: list_corpora
tools.description: List registered corpora with record count, idField, textFields, and whether each is indexed (semantic) or graphed. Read-only.

tools.name: index_corpus
tools.description: Build a local semantic embedding index (MiniLM, no API key) over a registered corpus so search_corpus matches by concept, not just keyword.

tools.name: search_corpus
tools.description: Search a registered corpus by keyword, blended with semantic similarity when indexed; optional exact-field filter. Returns matching records.

tools.name: graph_corpus
tools.description: Build a relationship graph over a registered corpus from edge rules ({relation, field, split?}) where a field's value references other records' ids; forward+reverse edges stored.

tools.name: query_corpus_graph
tools.description: Traverse a corpus graph: given a node id and relation, return neighbors forward or reverse, optionally transitively (e.g. ancestors/descendants).

tools.name: search_harmony
tools.description: Search the bundled Harmony (HarmonyLib) patching knowledge base — prefix/postfix/transpiler/finalizer semantics, injection parameters (__instance/__result/__state/___field), [HarmonyPatch] targeting, AccessTools/Traverse/CodeMatcher, patch ordering, RimWorld patterns and common gotchas. Hybrid semantic+keyword retrieval; self-building on first use. Use before writing or debugging a Harmony patch.

tools.name: harmony_graph
tools.description: Traverse the Harmony knowledge graph: from a record id, follow 'related' links to the surrounding cluster of concepts (forward/reverse, optionally transitive). Self-building on first use.

tools.name: rebuild_harmony_corpus
tools.description: Force a rebuild of the Harmony corpus (re-register from the bundled harmony-knowledge data, re-embed the semantic index, rebuild the graph). Run after editing harmony-corpus.jsonl; normally unnecessary.

tools.name: launch_quicktest
tools.description: Launches RimWorld with -quicktest to generate a test map instantly, booting from the CONFIGURED dev savedatafolder so it loads the modlist configure_active_mods set (not the player's default LocalLow config). Thin wrapper over launch_rimworld with quicktest enabled; arms the same idle watchdog. Pass bare:true for a minimal spawn using the player's default LocalLow config (no savedatafolder pinning or dev setup).

tools.name: capture_screen
tools.description: Capture the entire screen to an image file and return its path (read it with the Read tool). Pass focusGame:true to foreground the RimWorld window first so the grab lands on the game even after the launcher moves it to a separate virtual desktop.

tools.name: capture_game_window
tools.description: Screenshot a single RimWorld menu/dialog cropped to just that window. Foregrounds the game, captures, finds the window via the game's window stack, and crops to its rect. window: substring of the window's C# type (e.g. 'ModsConfig', 'ModSettings'); omit for the frontmost dialog. Returns the cropped image path.

tools.name: capture_gizmo
tools.description: Screenshot the selected thing's command buttons (gizmos), cropped. gizmo: label substring to isolate one button (e.g. 'Draft'); omit for the whole gizmo bar. Select a thing first with select_thing_at (in-game). Returns the cropped image path.

tools.name: capture_colonist_bar
tools.description: Screenshot the colonist bar at the top of the screen, cropped. colonist: name substring to isolate one portrait (e.g. 'Nate'); omit for the whole bar. No selection needed. Returns the cropped image path.

tools.name: capture_play_settings
tools.description: Screenshot the bottom-right map-overlay / play-settings toggle row, cropped. toggle: tooltip-label substring to isolate one button (e.g. 'roof'); omit for the whole row. Returns the cropped image path.

tools.name: capture_region
tools.description: Capture a specific region of the screen to an image file and return its path (read it with the Read tool). Pass focusGame:true to foreground the RimWorld window first (see capture_screen).

tools.name: get_screen_size
tools.description: Get the dimensions of the screen

tools.name: move_mouse
tools.description: Move the mouse cursor to a specific position

tools.name: get_mouse_position
tools.description: Get the current position of the mouse cursor

tools.name: click_mouse
tools.description: Click the mouse at the current position

tools.name: click_at
tools.description: Click the mouse at a specific position

tools.name: double_click
tools.description: Double-click the mouse at the current position

tools.name: double_click_at
tools.description: Double-click the mouse at a specific position

tools.name: scroll_mouse
tools.description: Scroll the mouse wheel

tools.name: drag_mouse
tools.description: Drag the mouse from current position to target position

tools.name: drag_mouse_from_to
tools.description: Drag the mouse from start position to end position

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text at the current cursor position

tools.name: type_text_with_delay
tools.description: Type text with a delay between keystrokes

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key

tools.name: press_key_shortcut
tools.description: Press a keyboard shortcut (combination of keys)

tools.name: hold_key
tools.description: Hold down a keyboard key

tools.name: release_key
tools.description: Release a held keyboard key

tools.name: get_clipboard_text
tools.description: Get text from the clipboard

tools.name: set_clipboard_text
tools.description: Set text to the clipboard

tools.name: copy_selected_text
tools.description: Copy selected text to clipboard and return it

tools.name: paste_text
tools.description: Paste text at current cursor position

tools.name: get_clipboard_image
tools.description: Get image from the clipboard (if available) as base64 data

tools.name: get_ui_element_info
tools.description: Finds a UI element within a specified window using UI Automation and returns its properties (Name, AutomationId, ClassName, ControlType, BoundingRectangle, IsEnabled, IsOffscreen, Value). Requires window title and at least one element identifier (name, automationId, or className).

tools.name: invoke_ui_element_action
tools.description: Performs an action (Click, SetValue, Focus) on a specified UI element found via UI Automation. Requires window title, action, and at least one element identifier. Requires valueToSet for the SetValue action.

tools.name: deploy_rimworld_mods
tools.description: Compiles C# assemblies and packages clean mod files into the target RimWorld Mods directory.

tools.name: launch_rimworld
tools.description: Closes existing RimWorld instances and launches a new one with developer, quicktest, or custom save data folder parameters. Supports loadSave to resume a save straight from launch. When launching into a map (quicktest/loadSave) it blocks until the map is live (waitForReady, default on) so a following bridge tool call won't race the load. Always runs a first-pass environment check after launch — active modlist + triaged startup Player.log (missing dependencies, Harmony failures, exceptions) — so a broken test setup is caught immediately. Arms an idle watchdog that autosaves and closes the game after a period with no MCP tool call, so it never runs unattended overnight.

tools.name: run_rimworld_tests
tools.description: Full automated test cycle: build the mods (and their Source.Tests projects) in dependency order, launch RimWorld with the in-game test runner (-synapse-test, hosted by the RimAgentic toolkit bridge), then classify the log. Stops early if the build fails. Returns the build summary plus [SYNAPSE-TEST] PASS/FAIL results and any errors. Requires the toolkit bridge mod to be active; it is forced to load last.

tools.name: read_rimworld_log
tools.description: Reads and triages RimWorld's Player.log. By default returns a classified summary — exceptions, Harmony patch failures, XML/def errors, missing dependencies, version and metadata warnings, plus any [SYNAPSE-TEST] PASS/FAIL results from the in-game test runner. Pass raw:true for an unfiltered tail instead.

tools.name: list_rimworld_saves
tools.description: Lists the saved games (.rws) in the dev save folder, newest first, with size and last-modified time. Use it to pick a slot for launch_rimworld's loadSave.

tools.name: submit_test_job
tools.description: Submit a RimWorld test-cycle job; returns a job_id immediately (non-blocking). Jobs run serially in isolated per-job savedatafolders. Optionally pin an exact modlist.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a submitted job's status and result by job_id. Persisted, survives a server restart.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List submitted jobs with their status; optional status filter.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a pending job (removes it from the queue). Running jobs cannot be cancelled mid-cycle.

tools.name: list_game_tools
tools.description: Retrieves the directory of all active gameplay tools exposed by RimSynapse Core inside the running RimWorld instance. Can optionally filter by a search query.

tools.name: execute_game_tool
tools.description: Executes an interactive gameplay tool inside RimWorld by name, passing a JSON arguments object.

tools.name: save_rimworld_game
tools.description: Saves the currently running RimWorld dev game to a named slot via the in-game bridge, so you can close the game and later resume this exact state with launch_rimworld's loadSave. Requires a live game (does nothing at the main menu).

tools.name: render_html_to_image
tools.description: Render an HTML infographic (file/string/URL) to a crisp PNG with headless Chrome/Edge: UTF-8-safe loopback serving, virtual-time budget for JS/fonts, forced light/dark theme, 2x scale, measured tight height.

tools.name: compose_infographic
tools.description: Generate themed, render-ready infographic HTML from structured data via built-in templates (timeline/roadmap, card-grid, stat-sheet) in the house design system.

tools.name: publish_infographic
tools.description: Fan a rendered infographic PNG out to every mod edition: commit About/<name>.png + a marker-managed README section to each GitHub repo, and upsert an imgur-hosted [img] section into each Steam Workshop description (CDP live update, handoff file fallback). Supports dryRun.

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token with 'repo' scope. Required for the GitHub issue, project and wiki tools; the RimWorld build/launch tools work without it.

rimagentic_root.title: Mod Workspace
rimagentic_root.description: Folder holding the RimWorld mod(s) you are developing — either a workspace whose child folders are mods, or a single mod repo. A mod is any folder with About/About.xml. The PowerShell harness ships inside this extension and is not looked for here.

rimworld_savedata.title: Dev Instance Save Folder
rimworld_savedata.description: Where the isolated dev instance of RimWorld keeps its saves, prefs and logs (passed as -savedatafolder). Must be on a drive this machine actually has; it is created if missing. Keep it separate from your normal RimWorld save folder.
